Questions

What does “Multi-vendor marketplace” cost?
The MVP costs $30,000–60,000 (UZS 360–725 mln), the full version $70,000–180,000 (UZS 840–2,165 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Multi-vendor marketplace” take?
The MVP takes 12–18 weeks, the full version 26–44 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Domain and hosting access; texts, photos and the logo; one person who makes the decisions.
